Evidence backing masterplan-v2 Sub-AC 3.2 and the e2e_loop_proof exit condition (full-cycle-card half); second full-cycle card after MPV2-0000.C001 (evidence/goals/fabric-loop-e2e-proof-run-20260702.json).

card.work_product: Strict fail-closed ledger listing in tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app: list_json_ids now surfaces every foreign directory entry (non-UTF-8 names, .json names failing the filesystem-safe id contract - unicode digits, spaces, dotfiles - and any other foreign name) as PlaneError::Corrupt instead of silently skipping; single documented carve-out for the atomic writer's own crash artifact <name>.json.tmp.<pid>; regression test foreign_ledger_filenames_fail_listing_closed probing every previously-skipped shape per-shape plus the flow-metrics ledger composition.

lane.coordinator_only_commits: All durable-plane writes and both git commits of this run were made by the coordinator on the isolated lane branch ooo/orch_edff8596cfa2; the reviewer subagent wrote no product source and no durable-plane state (only the gitignored .oya-loop-state/reviews/ verdict file, exactly per the review card contract).

stage_claim.ratification_gate: The claim command ran the mechanical founder-ratification dispatch gate against specs/masterplan.json before any plane write and granted dispatch (a stale or absent record would have refused with 'execution-wave dispatch refused: ...'; the gate's five refusal paths are covered by tests/ratification_gate.rs).
stage_claim.mechanism: oya-fabric-loop-state claim/start/heartbeat/check-disjoint through LoopStateService over CoordinationPlanePort + ExecutionPlanePort (owned Rust; no shell/python state manipulation); claim/heartbeat/run records on the gitignored operational plane .oya-loop-state, snapshotted here for durability.

stage_build.change: tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/lib.rs (+37/-1: is_atomic_write_tmp helper + strict fail-closed list_json_ids) and tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/tests/contract.rs (+96: foreign_ledger_filenames_fail_listing_closed regression test)
stage_build.result: green: 41/41 tests (17 lib unit + 8 bin unit + 11 contract + 5 ratification-gate), clippy clean, fmt clean
stage_build.build_iteration_note: First test run failed on macOS APFS refusing non-UTF-8 filename creation (EILSEQ) in the new regression test; fixed by guarding the probe to apply only where the filesystem can hold such a name (the shape is physically excluded where creation fails). All green after.

stage_review.block_record: run state marked blocked(needs-review) at 1783010268 while the independent reviewer ran; resumed running at 1783010572 after APPROVE
stage_review.reviewer_independence: Non-author executor-lane reviewer subagent in a separate session with no shared history, hostile-inspection (Torvalds-style) lens mandated; read-only on all tracked files; verdict delivered as a durable operational-plane file per the MPV2-0000.C002 learning.
stage_review.c002_learning_validated: The reviewer subagent's chat result artifact was lost AGAIN ('output artifact unavailable'), exactly the failure mode harvested as MPV2-0000.C002 in the first proof run - and the durable verdict-file protocol adopted from that learning carried the run without a redispatch. The closed-loop improvement layer demonstrably paid for itself this pass.

round_1.findings_summary: 0 blocker, 0 major, 3 minor, 3 nit. Minors: (1) dangling-symlink/TOCTOU-deleted <id>.json admitted then silently dropped by cards() (pre-existing tolerance); (2) directory named <id>.json fails as Io not Corrupt (pre-existing, verdict-class inconsistency); (3) tmp carve-out is a data-hiding channel (per-spec, flagged for the record). Nits: .DS_Store operational noise on dev machines (correct per fail-closed contract); non-UTF-8 branch only exercised on filesystems that can hold such names; a.json.tmp.1.json visually masquerades as tmp but is handled consistently.
round_1.rationale_excerpt: Traced every card-named shape through the new lister by hand; tmp recognizer byte-exact against write_atomic; both callers compose with no dead code and no panic path; live stores contain nothing the strict lister refuses; the regression test would fail against the pre-fix code; 41/41 green confirmed independently.

rework.disposition_of_findings: APPROVE with no blocker/major: actionable pre-existing minors harvested as durable backlog cards MPV2-0000.C008 and MPV2-0000.C009 (see learning_harvest), not churned as a rework round on an approved diff; per-spec/informational findings recorded here.
